question: After the stale-index cleanup is fixed, should this PR's default `sessions_search` tool and `operator.read` `sessions.search` Gateway method be accepted as the core transcript-search boundary for the protected session-recall issue?
rationale: The PR exposes transcript-content discovery over persisted session state, so automation cannot choose the permanent access scope, redaction contract, and index lifecycle without maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Approve Boundary After Repair
options.body: Accept the current read-scoped, visibility-filtered, redacted-snippet design once the stale-index cleanup bug is fixed and covered.

options.title: Narrow Search Scope
options.body: Require a stricter scope, caller restriction, or target restriction before exposing transcript-content search broadly.

options.title: Defer Core Search
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer session-content recall to stay under opt-in `memory_search` for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Boundary After Repair
recommendation.body: Accept the current read-scoped, visibility-filtered, redacted-snippet design once the stale-index cleanup bug is fixed and covered.
